attchmntText: Jaykay Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026
voiceSummary: Jaykay Enterprises Limited filed an investor release regarding consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Total income for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, stood at 116.16 crore, showing 69 percent year-on-year growth. Profit after tax was 8.66 crore. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, total income was 192.95 crore, a 32 percent increase. Profit after tax was 13.18 crore. The company received AS9100D Accreditation for its Precision Manufacturing Division. Subsidiary Allen Reinforced Plastics Ltd secured defence orders worth 60.01 crore from BrahMos Aerospace. The Devanahalli project is on track for completion by the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026-27 or the first quarter of fiscal year 2027-28. Regulatory approvals for medical implants were received from CDSCO. The company provided for delayed receivables due to business disruptions in the Middle East.

attchmntText: Jaykay Enterprises Limited has submitted to the Exchange the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Jaykay Enterprises Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. The Board reported a net profit of 49.42 lakh for the quarter and 50.68 lakh for the half year. The company issued 2,05,71,642 rights equity shares at a premium of Rs.74 per share on September 23, 2026. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee approved granting 13,000 employee stock options under the JKE Employee Stock Option Scheme 2025. The statutory auditors noted that the subsidiary Neumesh Labs Private Limited has a negative net worth of Rs. 3534.11 lakh and has paused commercial operations. No provision for credit impairment was recognized for the subsidiary. The financial results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and the statutory auditors.
